Introduction

Ka seini ne baseen, insulatan meyitenged te impanagne ni Sakariyas meyitenged te Hirusalim, wey te me guhuren meyitenged te impallateng ne Misiyas wey te katammanan ne peggukum. Nabaad seini ne baseen te daruwa: 1/ Kapitulu 1–8, ka panagne ni Sakariyas meyitenged te impakita kandin ne pegluwas te Hirusalim, ka pegbalew-balew te timplu, ka peglinis eyew egmatulus ka keet-etawan te Magbebaye ne Manama; 2/ Kapitulu 9–14, ka me guhuren meyitenged te impallateng ne Misiyas wey te katammanan ne peggukum.

This document (LIT reading_material), (was) written concerning what_ Sakariyas _prophesied about Hirusalim, and (concerning) the promised (LIT hoped_for) Messiah and the last judgment. This document is divided into two: 1/ Chapter 1–8, the predicting of Sakariyas concerning what was shown to him (about) saving of Hirusalim, the rebuilding of the temple, the cleaning so_that the people of the Lord God (MS Manama) become_holy; 2/ Chapter 9–14, the stories concerning the promised (LIT hoped_for) Messiah and the last judgment.

Impalintutuuwan ne insulat seini ne baseen te elat-elat te 520 wey te 518 ne leg-un te ware pad neetew ka Kristu.

It's believed that this document was_written between 520 and 518 years before the Christ was_born.

Ka pegpalibed te Manama te keet-etawan din

The causing_to_return of his people by God

11 [xr]Te igkawalu ne bulan te igkarangeb ne leg-un te peghari ni Daryu diye te Pirsya, migpanengneng ka Magbebaye ne Manama ki prupita Sakariyas ne anak ni Birikiyas wey apu ni Idu. 2 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye si Sakariyas, “Amana a nabelu te me kaap-apuan niyu. 3 Purisu lalahi nu ka me etew te seini ka inlalag ku te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, ‘Libed kew kayi te keddi wey eglibed a degma kaniyu. 4 Kene kew iling te kaap-apuan niyu. Napangguhuran e sikandan te me prupita dengan ne egpeengkeren ku te maddeet ne me himu ran piru ware sikandan migpammineg wey ke miglinga-linga naa keddiey.’ 5 Migpatey e ka me kaap-apuan niyu wey ka seeye ne me prupita. 6 Piru te ware pad sikandan migpatey, neyitabu pad diye te kandan ka impalalag ku wey ka impepaney-paney ku kandan te me suluhuanen ku ne me prupita. Sikan naa ka mig-inniyug ka me kaap-apuan niyu te me sale dan wey migkahi, ‘Neyitabu en iya kanta ka ingkahi te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye ne eglegparan ki nikandin tenged te me hinimuwan ta.’ ”

11 [xr]On the eight month of the second year of the kinging by Daryu there in Pirsya, the Lord God informed prophet Sakariyas the child of Birikiyas and grandchild of Idu. 2 And the Lord said to Sakariyas, “I'm very angry at your(pl) ancestors. 3 Therefore tell(sg) the people I the Very Powerful Lord said this, ‘Return(pl) here to me and I will_ also _return to you(pl). 4 Don't(pl) be like your(pl) ancestors. They were_told by the prophets long_ago that I wanted_(them)_to_cease their evil actions but they didn't listen or pay_attention to_me.’ 5 Your(pl) ancestors and those prophets died already. 6 But before they died, what_(I)_caused_to_be_told and what_(I)_warned_ them _with my servants the prophets happened to them yet. That's why your(pl) ancestors turned_from their sins and said, ‘It_happened now/really to us(excl) what_was_said by the Very Strong/Powerful Lord that he will_punish us(excl) due to our(incl) actions.’ ”

Ka me kudde ne impakita ki Sakariyas

The horses shown to Sakariyas

7 Te igkararuwa ne pulu wey hep-at (24) ne aldew te igkasapulu wey sabeka (11) ne bulan te Sibat, migpanengneng e man-e ka Magbebaye ne Manama ki prupita Sakariyas ne anak ni Birikiyas wey apu ni Idu. Igkarangeb pad seeye ne leg-un te peghari ni Daryu. 8 [xra][xrb]Migkahi si Sakariyas ka migpangguhud, “Sabeka ne marusilem, due etew ne impakita keddiey ne migpangudde te malalab! Ne diye seini migsanggel te taliware te me kayu ne mirtul, diye te napu. Ne diye te keinniyuhan din, due migmangudde te mallalab, meebul, wey memaangkag. 9 Ne due degma panalihan ne duma ku wey mig-insaan ku sikandin, ‘Ahalen, hentew ka sika se migmangudde?’

7 On the twenty fourth (24) day of the eleventh (11) month of Sibat, the Lord God informed again prophet Sakariyas the child of Birikiyas and grandchild of Idu. It was still the second year of the kinging by Daryu. 8 [xra][xrb]Sakariyas said as (he) retell, “One night/evening, there_was_shown to_me a person riding_a_horse that was red! And he/it stopped there in between the mirtul trees, there in the valley. And there behind him, were (those) riding_horses red, gray, and white (ones). 9 And there_was an angel that was with me and I asked him/her, ‘Master, who are those riding_horses?’

“Ne migtabak ka panalihan, ‘Igpangguhud ku keykew ke hentew sika se migmangudde.’10 Nataman, impangguhuran ad te seeye se migpangudde ne migsanggel diye te taliware te me kayu ne mirtul. Migkahi sikandin, ‘Insuhu sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew egpitew ke nekey ka egkengeyitabu te intiru ne kalibutan.’

“And the angel answered, ‘I will_tell you(sg) who are those riding_horses.’10 Then, I was_told by the one_riding_a_horse that stopped there in the middle of the mirtul trees. He said, ‘They were commanded by the Lord God in_order to look_out what's happening in the entire world.’

11 “Ne impanugtulan te migmangudde ka seeye se panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne migsasindeg diye te taliware te me kayu ne mirtul. Migkahi sikandan, ‘Neempet ney e ka intiru ne kalibutan wey ware samuk ne nakita ney.’

11 “And that angel of the Lord God who stood there between the mirtul trees was reported_to by (those) riding_horses. They said, ‘We(excl) encircled the entire world and no trouble that we(excl) saw.’

12 “Ne mig-insaan te seeye ne panalihan ka Manama, ‘Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, ken-u nu naan pad igkeyid-u ka Hirusalim wey ka me lungsud te Huda ne ingkalangeti nu te pitu ne pulu (70) e ne leg-un?’

12 “And that angel asked God, ‘God who is Very Strong/Powerful, when will_ you(sg) _have_mercy on Hirusalim and the towns of Huda that you(sg) were_angry_at for seventy (70) years?’

13 “Ne meupiya wey egpakabagget ka intabak te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te panalihan din ne migpakiglalag keddi. 14 Ne ingkahiyan a te panalihan ne migpakiglalag keddi, ‘Ipangguhud nu naa ka seini se igpepangguhud keddi te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye: Amana ku geyinawei wey igkeipeng ka Hirusalim ne egngaranan ded te Siyun. 15 Piru amana a nabelu te me nasud ne hendue te ware igkabantali. Kene e red amana egkabelu kandan dengan, piru impasublaan dan mule te egbayad-bayad ka keet-etawan ku. 16 Purisu, egliberan ku red ka Hirusalim ne igkeyid-u ku, wey igbalew-balew ku igpasasindeg ka timplu ku wey ka Hirusalim.[fn]’ ”

13 “And the Lord God's answer with his angel that spoke to me was good and encouraging. 14 And I was_told by the angel who conversed_with me, ‘Tell(sg) this that is_cause_to_tell by the Very Strong/Powerful Lord with me: I greatly love and am_concerned_about Hirusalim that's also named Siyun. 15 But I'm very angry at the nations that seem to have nothing to_be_concerned_about. My anger is not very_great before, but on_the_contrary they excessively persecuted my people. 16 Therefore, I will_return_to Hirusalim that I will_show_mercy_to, and I will_redo to_build my temple and Hirusalim.[fn]’ ”

17 Ne ingkahiyan a te panalihan te igpalalag e man-e seini, “Migkahi ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye ne egmatubungen din ded man-e ka me siyudad te Huda. Ne egbaggeten din ded ka keet-etawan te Siyun[fn]; eg-alamen din ded ka Hirusalim ne siyudad din.”

17 And I was_told by the angel to again tell this, “The Very Strong/Powerful Lord says that he will_prosper again the cities of Huda. And he will_encourage the people of Siyun[fn]; he will_choose Hirusalim again to be his city.”

Ka me sungey ne impakita ki Sakariyas

The horns shown to Sakariyas

18 “Te pegpitew ku man-e, iyan kud iya se hep-at ne sungey. 19 Ne mig-insa a te panalihan te Manama, ‘Nekey naa ka igpasabut te sika se hep-at ne sungey?’

18 “At my looking again, what_ I _saw was four horns. 19 And I asked the angel of God, ‘What's the meaning of those four horns?’

“Ne migtabak sikandin, ‘Ka sika ne me sungey, iyan sika ka me nasud ne migpegsuwey-suwey te keet-etawan te Huda, te Israil, wey te Hirusalim.’

“And he answered, ‘Those horns, (are) the nations that scattered the people of Huda, of Israil, and of Hirusalim.’

20 “Ne due impapitew keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama ne hep-at ne etew ne mannayab. 21 Ne mig-insa a, ‘Nekey ka eggimuwen dan?’

20 “And there were four people forging_metal that the Lord God showed me. 21 And I asked, ‘What are they doing?’

“Ne migtabak sikandin, ‘Miggendini sikandan eyew egginaaldek wey egdereet te me nasud ne migpanaman-taman migdereet te Huda wey migpegsuwey-suwey te me mahinged.’ ”

“And he answered, ‘They came_here in_order for terrifying and demolishing the nations that destroyed Huda severely and scattered the locals.’ ”

Ka etew ne mig-uyan te igseked

The person who brought a measuring_device

21 Te pegpitew ku man-e, iyan kud e se etew ne miggen-gen te lubid ne igseked. 2 Ne mig-insaan ku sikandin, “Egpeendei kaa?”

21 When I looked again, there_was a person (LIT I saw a person) holding a rope for measuring. 2 And I asked him, “Where_are_ you(sg) _going?”

Ne migtabak sikandin, “Eggendiya a te Hirusalim su egsekeren ku ke mamenu kaluag wey kalayat ka sika ne siyudad.”

And he answered, “I am going to Hirusalim because I'll measure how wide and long that city (is).”

3 Ne mig-awe e ka panalihan ne migpakiglalag keddi wey due degma panalihan ne migsinug-ung kandin, 4 wey ingkahiyan sikandin, “Apas ka pallahuy wey ilalag nu seini te seeye se kanakan ne miggen-gen te lubid ne igseked, ‘Egkaawe ka matikang wey makepal ne alad ne batu te siyudad te Hirusalim su amane e ne masulug ka me etew wey ka me ayam. 5 Migsaad ka Magbebaye ne Manama ne sikandin ka egkeyimu ne alad ne hapuy ne eglingut te Hirusalim, wey sikandin ka egkabantug te sika ne siyudad.’ ”

3 And the angel that conversed with_me left and there_was another angel also_that met him, 4 and he was_told, “Run(sg) quickly and say(sg) this to that unmarried_man holding a rope for measuring, ‘The stone wall (LIT high and thick stone wall) of Hirusalim will_be_removed because the people and the domestic_animals are too many. 5 Because the Lord God promised that he would_become a fence of fire that surrounds Hirusalim, and he will_be_honored in that city.’ ”

Ka pegpeuli te Manama te nenaddakep

The sending_home of the captured(pl) by God

6-7 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka keet-etawan din, “Keiyal kew awe due te Babilunya! Impegsuwey-suwey ku sikaniyu te minsan hendei.[fn] Piru kuntee, awe kew e due wey libed kew e diye te Hirusalim. 8 Minsan hentew ne eg-ehet wey egdereet kaniyu, nekeiling de te egdereetan kew se amana ku geyinawei.[fn]”

6-7 And the Lord God said to his people, “Leave(pl) quickly there in Babilunya! I scattered(pl) you(pl) to wherever.[fn] But now, leave(pl) from there and return(pl) there to Hirusalim. 8 Whoever fights and destroys you(pl), it's just like they destroyed you(pl) whom I greatly love(d).[fn]”

Seini pad man-e ka ingkahi keddi te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye meyitenged te me nasud ne mig-ahew te karatuan te keet-etawan din:9 “Pammineg kew, eglegparan[fn] ku iya sikandan wey egpangahawan degma sikandan te me uripen dan.”

This is what_was_told to_me also by the Very Strong/Powerful Lord concerning the nations that plunder his people:9 “Look(pl), I will_ indeed _punish[fn] them and they will_be_plundered also by their slaves.”

Emun ke egkeyitabu e seini, egkatahaan niyu ne ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye ka migsuhu keddi.

If/when this happens, you(pl) will_know that the God who is Very Strong/Powerful is the (one who) commanded/sent me.

10 Ne migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “Me keet-etawan te Hirusalim,[fn] ulahing kew te kahalaan su eggenduen ad te kaniyu wey duen ad e eg-ugpe!”

10 And the Lord God said, “People of Hirusalim,[fn] sing(pl) for joy because I am_coming to you(pl) and I will_live there!”

11 Te sika ne timpu, masulug ka me nasud ne egparani keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama wey egkeyimu sikandan ne keet-etawan ku, wey eg-ugpa a duma kandan.” Ke egkeyitabu e sika, egkanengnengan niyu ne iyan migsuhu keddi ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye eyew eggendini te kaniyu. 12 Eg-angkenen te Magbebaye ka Huda ne kandin ne baad puun te matulus ne tane, wey eg-alamen din ded man-e ka Hirusalim.

11 At that time, many nations will_approach me the Lord God and they will_become my people, and I will_live_among with them.” If that happens, you(pl) will_know that it's the God who is Very Strong/Powerful who commanded me in_order to come_here to_you(pl). 12 Huda will_be_owned by the Lord as his portion from the holy land, and he will_ again _choose Hirusalim.

13 Peeneng-eneng kew se langun ne etew due te tangkaan te Magbebaye, su egbukal-bukal e sikandin diye te matulus ne ugpaan din.

13 Be_silent(pl) you(pl) all people in front of the Lord God, because he is_rising there in his holy residence.

Si Huswi wey si Meibulan

Huswi (Joshua) and Satan (MS Meibulan)

31 [xra][xrb]Ne duen e man-e impakita keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama. Impakita keddi si Huswi, ka Labew ne Talagpanubad ne migsasindeg diye te tangkaan te panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne migsasindeg degma si Meibulan diye te igkakawanan ni Huswi eyew egpamalehet te bayung din kandin. 2 [xr]Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Meibulan, “Peeneng-eneng ka Meibulan! Peeneng-eneng kad kuntee! Sikeddi ka Magbebaye ne Manama ne mig-alam te Hirusalim. Ne si Huswi egpekeiling te kayu ne egpakatemeg e perem ne nasalukagmit naan de.”

31 [xra][xrb]And there_is also something_else that the Lord God shown to_me. He showed me Huswi, the Prominent Sacrificer who stands/stood in front of the angel of the Lord God. And Satan also stood on the right_side of Huswi in_order to testify on his accusation of him. 2 [xr]And the Lord God said to Satan, “Stop(sg) Satan! Be_silent(sg) now! I (am) the Lord God that chose Hirusalim. And Huswi is like wood that has_been_thrown into the fire and has been_snatched yet.”

3 Te seeye ne timpu, biluwen ka kumbale ni Huswi te migsasindeg diye te tangkaan te panalihan. 4 Ne ingkahiyan te panalihan ka duma ne me panalihan ne migmanasindeg diye te tangkaan ni Huswi, “Luunga niyu ka biluwen ne kumbale ni Huswi.” Ne ingkahiyan degma te panalihan si Huswi, “In-awe kud ka me sale nu. Ne kuntee, egpakumbalaan kud sikeykew te malinis ne kumbale.” 5 Ne migkahi a, “Salakayi niyu degma sikandin te malinis ne salakey.” Seeye naa ka insalakayan dan e sikandin te malinis wey ingkumbalaan e taheed te migsasindeg diye te marani ran ka panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama.

3 At that time, Huswi's clothes was dirty stood in_front of the angel. 4 And the angel said to the other angels that stood(pl) in front of Huswi, “Take_off(pl) the dirty clothes of Huswi.” And the angel also said to Huswi, “I have removed your(sg) sins. And now, I will_dress you(sg) in clean clothe(s).” 5 And I said, “Put_a_headband(pl) on him also_that's a clean headband.” So then they headbanded him with clean (one) and they had_(him)_dressed while the angel of the Lord God stood close to them.

6 Ne innangenan te panalihan te Manama si Huswi 7 meyitenged te inlalag te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye ne miggenendue, “Emun ke egtumanen nu ka me suhu ku wey eg-ikulen nu ka me tulumanen, sikeykew ka egpepanguluwen ku diye te timplu ku, wey diye te in-alad ne lama te timplu. Ne egkaayun ke pad man-e ne egparani keddi iling te me panalihan ne migsasindeg kayi te tangkaan ku. 8 [xr]Ne kuntee, pammineg ke naa Huswi se Labew ne Talagpanubad, wey sikaniyu se me talagpanubad ne me duma rin. Sikaniyu ka palinneu te me meupiya ne egkeyitabu, su mahaan kud e igpeendue ka suluhuanen ku ne egngaranan te Sugpang. 9 Tengtengi nu naa Huswi ka batu ne intahu ku due te tangkaan nu ne pitu se mata. Egkulitan ku ka batu, wey eg-aween ku ka sale te seini ne inged te senge-kaaldew re. 10 [xr]Te sika ne aldew, egmeyingnginggatey kew te me sumbaley niyu ne egpinnuu diye te lebut te me pinamula niyu ne me paras wey me kayu ne iggira.” Sika ka ingkahi te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye.

6 And the angel of God informed Huswi 7 concerning what_ the Very Strong/Powerful Lord _had_said going, “If/when you(sg) obey my commands and follow(pl) the rules/beliefs, I will_cause_ you(sg) _to_lead/be_in_charge_of my temple, and there the fenced yard of the temple. And you(sg) will_be_able to come_close to me like the angels who stood/stand here in_front of me. 8 [xr]And now, listen(sg) Huswi the Prominent Sacrificers, and you(pl) sacrificers who (are) his companions. You(pl) (are) the sign(s) of good things to happen, because I am about to send_there my servant named the Branch. 9 Look(sg) Huswi at the stone that I've placed in front of you(sg) that has seven eyes. I will_engrave on the stone, and I will_remove the sin of the people of this place in just one day. 10 [xr]On that day, you(pl) will_invite_each_other your(pl) neighbor to sit under (LIT buttock) your(pl) vineyard and of the fig tree(s).” That is what_ the Very Strong/Powerful Lord _said.

The holder of the lamp and the two olives

[xr]And I was_told by the angel, “Those seven lamps, they (are) the eye(s) of the Lord God who can_see the entire place/world.”

3 Ne ingkahiyan a te panalihan, “Nasulat te sika ne baseen ne egdilusen e ka keet-etawan te intiru ne inged te Israil. Nasulat diye te limang te baseen ne seeye se me takawen, egguleen. Ne nasulat degma diye te limang te baseen ne seeye se egpamalehet te ubat, egguleen ded degma.” 4 Migkahi ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, “Egdilusen ku iya seeye se me takawen wey egpamalehet te ubat ne eggamit te ngaran ku. Written on one_side of the document is that those thieves, will_be_destroyed. And it's also written on one_side of the document that those who testify with lie(s), will_ also _be_destroyed.” 4 The Very Strong/Powerful Lord said, “I will_curse really those thieves and to those who testify with lie(s) using my name. Ka daruwa ne talagtameng te karniru

4 Ne migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama ku, “Tangguwa nu ka me karniru ne intahahe ne egpanggilangen. 5 Ka minsan hentew ne egbeli wey eglape te me karniru, kene eglegparan. Seeye degma se migbelegye, egkahi, ‘Egdayanen ka Magbebaye ne Manama su naratu ad e.’ Ne minsan ka talagtameng, kenad egkeyid-u.”

4 And the Lord my God said, “Take_care(sg) the sheep that are prepared to be_butchered(pl). 5 Whoever buys and also butchers the sheep, won't be_punished. And those who sell (them), say, ‘Praise the Lord God because I've become wealthy.’ And even the watcher, has no compassion (for_them).”

6 Ne migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “Kena ad e egkeyid-u te me etew ne nangugpe te seini ne inged. Igpeuripen kud sikandan te me sumbaley ran ded wey te Hari dan ne iyan ded egdereet te tane dan. Ne warad iya sabeka kandan ne egluwasen ku.”

6 And the Lord God says, “I will_ no_longer _have_compassion for the people that live(pl) in this place. I will_cause_ them _to_be_enslaved by their neighbor(s) only and by their king who were the ones that destroy their land. And there's_not one of them that I will_save.”

7 Sikan naa ka neyimu a ne talagtameng te me karniru[fn] ne intahahe ne egpanggilangen te me nigusyanti. Ne migkuwa a te daruwa ne tuked, ka sabeka ingngaranan ku te “Keupianan” wey ka dangeb ingngaranan ku te “Pegsabeka,” wey intamengan ku ka me karniru. 8 Nataman ne napelaan ad te tatelu ne talagtameng te me karniru ne nabbelu keddi. Sikan naa ka impaawe kud e sikandan seled de te sabeka ne bulan. 9 Ne migkahi a diye te me karniru, “Kena ad e egtanggu kaniyu. Balahad e ke egkapatey seeye se egpatey iya, wey balahad e ke egkalaag seeye se egkalaag iya. Ne balahad e ke egmare-deesey ka nenasame.[fn]”

7 That's why I became a watcher of sheeps[fn] that are prepared to be_butchered(pl) by the sellers. And I got two staffs, one I had named “Goodness/Peace” and the other I had named “Unity,” and I looked_after the sheep. 8 Then I became_impatient at three watchers of sheep that were angry(pl) at_me. That's why I removed them in (LIT inside) one month. 9 Therefore I said to the sheep, “I won't watch_over you(pl) any_longer. Let the ones who die to die indeed, and let the ones to be lost to be lost indeed. And let those who are left to devour_each_other.[fn]”

10 Ne ingkuwa ku ka tuked ku ne ingngaranan ku te “Keupianan” wey inggepu ku seini palinneu ne kenad e igpabulus te Magbebaye ne Manama ka kasabutan din diye te langun ne keet-etawan. 11 Ne warad karuan te kasabutan te seeye ne aldew. Ne seeye se me nigusyanti te me karniru ne migpipitew keddiey, nenakanengneng sikandan ne seeye se inggimu ku, lalag te Magbebaye ne Manama. 12 [xr][xr]Ne ingkahiyan ku sikandan, “Ke suman-suman niyu ne eleg a ne egbayaran, ne bayari a nikaniyu. Piru ke kene, balahad e.” Purisu imbayaran a nikandan te tatelu ne pulu (30) ne pelata.

10 And I took my staff that I had named “Goodness/Peace” and I broke it as a sign that the Lord God wouldn't continue his agreement to all people. 11 And the agreement will_ no_longer _be_effective that day. And those sellers of the sheep that were watching me, they knew that what_ I _did, was the word of the Lord God. 12 [xr][xr]And I told them, “If you(pl) think that I am_worthy (LIT right) to be paid, then pay me. But if not, ignore (it).” Therefore I was paid thirty (30) silver_coins by_them.

13 Ne ingkahiyan a te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Itahu nu sika diye te tahuanan te seleppi diye te timplu.”[fn] Purisu, ingkuwa ku ka seleppi ne pelata ne tatelu ne pulu (30) ne egkahiyen dan ne dakel kun ubag ne bayad dan keddi, wey intahu kud e seini diye te tahuanan te seleppi diye te timplu te Magbebaye. 14 Ne inggepu kud e man-e ka dangeb ne tuked ku ne ingngaranan ku te “Pegsabeka,” palinneu te warad nasabeka ka Huda wey ka Israil.

13 And I was_told by the Lord God, “Put that in the container of money there in the temple.”[fn] Therefore, I took the thirty (30) silver (coins) that they thought_wrongly was a large payment for_me, and I put it into the container of money there in the temple of the Lord. 14 And then I broke again my second staff that I had named “Unity,” a sign that Huda and Israil were_ no_longer _unified.

15 Ne ingkahiyan ad e man-e te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Abey ke pa man-e tanggu te me karniru, piru palalung-lalung ka.[fn] 16 Su egpalepawen ku te inged ka sabeka ne talagtameng te me karniru ne egbalaharen ka eggilangen, kene egpamitew te egkatarin, kene egbawi te egkapiulan, wey kene egtanggu te meupiya se peglelawa. Nasi din mule egpangeena ka mallambeg ne me karniru, wey egpanggusien din pad ka me sulu.

15 And I was_told again by the Lord God, “Watch(sg) again the sheep(pl) one_more_time, but act_as_stupid (one)(sg).[fn] 16 Because I will_cause_ a (LIT one) watcher of sheep _to_appear on earth/place that ignores (any)_to_be_slaughtered, doesn't look for (any) lost, doesn't heal if there's (any) lame/maimed, and he doesn't look_after healthy sheep. But he on_the_contrary eats the fat(pl) sheep, and he even splits (their) hooves.

17 “Mekeyid-u-hid-u ka lalung ne talagtameng te me karniru

ne mig-engked te intamengan din!

Ka egginguma ne kaluwasan te Huda wey Israil

The coming salvation of Huda and Israil

121 Seini ka lalag te Magbebaye ne Manama meyitenged te Israil, “Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka miggimu te langit wey migtumpi te tane, wey migbehey te umul te etew. 2 Mahaan kud e eggimuwa ka Hirusalim ne egpekeiling te binu[fn] ne egpekewubug te me inged ne nakalingut dutu. Minsan ka duma ne me siyudad te Huda egkalagkes degma ke eglusuran ka Hirusalim. 3 Piru te pegginguma kangkuwa te seeye ne aldew, eggimuwen ku ka Hirusalim ne egpekeiling te mabehat ne batu para te langun ne etew. Ne ka minsan hentew ne eggeram eggenat kayi, egluehan de iya. Ne egsabbeka ka langun ne inged eyew eglusud te Hirusalim. 4 Piru te seeye kangkuwa ne aldew, egginalatan ku ka langun ne kudde, wey egkengalibeg e ka nanguntud. Egbantayan ku ka keet-etawan te Huda piru egbuturen ku ka me kudde te me kuntere dan. 5 Ne egkahi diye te suman-suman dan ka me pangulu te Huda, ‘Me maresen ka nangugpe te Hirusalim tenged su iyan dan Manama ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye.’

121 This is the word of the Lord God concerning Israil, “I (am) the Lord God who made the sky/heaven and flattened/formed the ground, and gave life to people. 2 I'll soon make Hirusalim like wine[fn] that causes_ the other places _drunk that surround it. And the other cities of Huda will_be_included when Hirusalim will_be_attacked. 3 But when that day arrives later, I will_make Hirusalim like a heavy stone for all people. And whoever tries lifting it, will_ just _be_fatigued indeed. And all the people will_unite_as_one in_order for invading Hirusalim. 4 But on that later day, I will_threaten all the horses, and the (ones) riding(pl) (them) will_be_confused. I will_guard the people of Husa but I will_blind the horses of their enemies. 5 And the leaders of Huda will_say to themselves (LIT to their minds), ‘The (ones who) live in Hirusalim are strong because the Very Strong Lord is their God.’

6 “Te sika kangkuwa ne aldew, eggimuwen ku ka me pangulu te Huda ne egpekeiling te baha diye te intemehan, wey egpekeiling te sulu ne indullit diye te me lahami. Egdereetan dan ka langun ne keet-etawan te inged ne nakalingut kandan. Piru ka keet-etawan te Hirusalim, kene mule egkamenu diye te nangugpaan dan.

6 “On that later day, I will_make the leaders of Huda like embers of the burning_pile, and like blazing lamp(s) that are ignited in the straw. They will_destroy all the people of that surround them. But the people of Hirusalim, won't be affected on_the_contrary in their residences.

7 “Ne eggun-aan ku egpepanaluwa ka me matig-Huda eyew kene egkeilingan ka kabantug dan te kabantug te kabuhalan ni Dabid wey te me matig-Hirusalim. 8 Te sika kangkuwa ne aldew, egpangabangan ku ka me matig-Hirusalim, wey minsan ka me malletey, egmemakeseg e iling ki Dabid. Ne ka me kabuhalan ni Dabid egpekeiling te Manama, wey egpekeiling e te Panalihan te Magbebaye ne egpangulu te me matig-Hirusalim. 9 Te sikan ded kangkuwa ne aldew, egdereetan ku ka langun ne nasud ne eglusud te Hirusalim.

7 “And I will first cause_to_be_victorious those (who) live(pl) in Huda so_that their honor won't be surpassed by the honor of the descendant(s) of Dabid and of those (who) (are) from_Hirusalim. 8 On that later day, I will_help those (who) (are) from_Hirusalim, and even the weak, will_be_strong like Dabid. And the descendants of Dabid will_be_like God, like the Spirit of the Lord who lead those (who) (are) from_Hirusalim. 9 Also on that later day, I will_destroy all the nations that are attacking Hirusalim.

10 [xr][xr]“Eggipenuen ku te panisingan ne hiimenawen wey maampu-ampu ka me kabuhalan ni Dabid wey ka me matig-Hirusalim. Egtengtengan a nikandan se innimatayan[fn] dan wey egmakapandalawit sikandan, iling te etew ne impatayan te sabsabeka ne anak wey ke egdamag naa te panganey ne anak din. 11 Te sika kangkuwa ne aldew, egmataman-taman egmandalawit ka me matig-Hirusalim iling te pegdamag ki Hadad-Rimun diye te napu te Migidu. 12-14 Egmandalawit ka tagse talaanak diye te inged te Israil: ka me pamilya te kabuhalan ni Dabid, ni Natan, ni Libi, ni Simii, wey ka duma pad ne me pamilya. Egsuwey re due egmandalawit ka me lukes, wey egsuwey-suwey re due degma ka me asawa ran.”

10 [xr][xr]“I will_fill the descendants of Dabid and those (who) (are) from_Hirusalim with a compassionate and prayerful spirit. They will_look_at me the (one that) they have_killed[fn] and they will_weep, like a person that (their) only child died or bereaved of his/her eldest child. 11 On that later day, the inhabitants of Hirusalim will unceasingly weep like the weeping for Hadad-Rimun there on the plain of Migidu. 12-14 Each family there in the land/place of Israil will_weep(pl): the families of descendants of Dabid, of Natan, of Libi, of Simii, and of other families. The males will_weep(pl) separately, and their spouses will (weep) also separately.”

Ka peglinis te me sale te matig-Israil

The cleaning of the sins of the (ones) from_Israil

131 Ne migkahi pad man-e ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, “Te sika ne aldew, due weyig ne egtulayas diye te me kabuhalan ni Dabid wey te me matig-Hirusalim, eyew egkalinisan sikandan te me sale dan wey te kalindit dan.

131 And the Very Prominent/Strong Lord said again, “On that later day, there will_be_a water that will_flow to the descendant(s) of Dabid and to the (ones) from_Hirusalim, so_that they will_be_cleaned_up with their sins and of their impurities.

2 “Te seeye kangkuwa ne aldew, eg-aween ku ka langun ne diyus-diyus diye te inged te Israil wey kenad e seini egkatanuran. Ne egpandelrelen ku ka kene ne mallehet ne me prupita wey ka me tumanud[fn] dan. 3 Ke duen pad man-e egpanagne, ka amey wey ka iney e te egpanagne ka egkahi kandin, ‘Keilangan ne egpatey ka su migpangguhud ka te inlalag kun te Magbebaye ne Manama, kunaleg te ubat bes.’ Ne emun ke egpabulus-bulus pad sikandin, egdugsuan e sikandin te amey rin wey te iney rin. 4 Te sika kangkuwa ne aldew, igkeyilew e te me prupita ka igmangguhud dan ne impakita kun kandan. Kenad sikandan egsaluub te bulbulen ne kumbale eyew egpakapanlimbung pad. 5 Purisu egkahi naan de sikandan, ‘Kene key ma ne prupita. Talagbasukan key wey sikan en iya ka himu ney minsan te bate key pad.[fn]’ 6 Ne emun ke due eg-inse kandan, ‘Mania te napalpalian ka lawa niyu?’[fn] Ne egtabak sikandan, ‘Napalpalian key diye te baley te alukuy ney.’ ”

2 “On that later day, I will_remove all the false_gods there in the place of Israil and these will_ no_longer _be_remembered. And I will_chase_away the not true prophet(s) and their spirit(s).[fn] 3 If there_is (someone) still prophesying, the father and the mother of the one prophesying will_say to him, ‘It's_necessary that you(sg) are killed because you(sg) told something that reportedly spoken the Lord God, but_on_the_contrary it's a lie.’ And if he still continues, he will_be_stabbed by his father and mother. 4 On that later day, the prophets will_be_ashamed of their stories that reportedly shown to them. They will_ no_longer _dress in hairy clothes in_order to be_able_to_cheat. 5 Therefore they will_ just _say, ‘We(excl) (are) not a prophet. We(excl) are land_cultivator and that indeed has been our(excl) work since we(excl) were still children.[fn]’ 6 And if/when there's (someone) asks them, ‘Why is your(pl) body[fn] wounded?’ Then they will_answer, ‘We(excl) were_wounded at the house of our(excl) friend.’ ”

Ka pegkapatey te talagtameng te me karniru

The death of the watcher of sheep

7 [xr]Ne migkahi ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye,

7 [xr]And the Very Strong Lord said,

“Himata ka, kampilan.

“Wake_up(sg), sword.

Lusuri nu ka impatameng ku te me karniru,

Attack(sg) the one I caused_to_watch the sheep,

ka etew ne in-alam ku ne pangulu te keet-etawan ku.

the person I chose to be a leader of my people.

Himatayi nu sikandin

Kill(sg) him

eyew egmemekegsuwey-suwey e ka me karniru.

so_that the sheep will_scatter(pl).

Egdereetan ku ka keet-etawan[fn] ku.

I will_destroy my people.[fn]

8 Te intiru ne inged te Israil,

8 In the whole place Israil,

daruwa ne baad te keet-etawan ka egpatey,

two divisions of people will_die,

wey sabeka naan de ne baad ka egkengeuyag.

and just one division will_live.

9 Ne eglinisan ku egpaay-ayari seeye se nenasame,

9 And I will_clean the remainder thoroughly,

iling te pelata wey bulawan ne eglalaben te hapuy.

like a silver and gold forge by fire.

Ne egpangananey sikandan keddi,[fn]

And they will_request_help from me,[fn]

wey egtabaken ku sikandan.

and I will_answer them.

Ne egkahi a, ‘Sikaniyu ka keet-etawan ku,’

And I will_say, ‘You(pl) (are) my people,’

wey egkahi degma sikandan,

and they will_ also _say,

‘Sikeykew Magbebaye ka Manama ney.’ ”

‘You(sg) Lord is our(excl) God.’ ”

Eglepew ka Manama wey eghari

God appears and kings

141 Ne eggingume e ka aldew te peggukum te Magbebaye ne Manama. Te seeye kangkuwa ne timpu, egpangahawan kew te me kuntere niyu te me kasangkapan niyu, wey egba-baaren dan diye te tangkaan niyu, me matig-Hirusalim. 2 Ne eglibulungen te Magbebaye ka langun ne keet-etawan te me nasud eyew egpakigkuntere te Hirusalim. Ne egkaahew ran ka siyudad wey egpanakawan dan ka me baley, wey egpamehesen dan te eggilabet ka me malitan. Ne egkabaad ka me mahinged; egkarakep ka senge-baad wey eg-uyanen diye te mariyu, wey egkahaat ded ka senge-baad diye te siyudad. 3 Ne egpakig-ehet ka Magbebaye te seeye ne me nasud, iling te pegpakig-ehet din dengan. 4 Te seeye kangkuwa ne aldew, egsasindeg sikandin diye te Bubungan te me Ulibu ne diye dapit te egkatangkaan te Hirusalim dapit te igsile. Egkaperi ka bubungan puun te igsile peendiye te iglineb wey egmapatag e ka elat iling te luluahi ne napu. Ne egpekegtalipag e ka nabaad ne bubungan; ka senge-baad egpekeendiye te igkahibang ne balabahan, wey ka baad egpekeendiye te igkakawanan ne balabahan. 5 Ne egpamallahuy kew ka egpariyu te bubungan te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey diye kew egbaye te bangalug ne egleus diye te Askal. Eggulunsuwey kew ka egpamallahuy iling dengan te due linug te si Usiyas pad ka mighari te Huda. Egkataman, eggingume e ka Magbebaye ne Manama ku ne egdumaan te me panalihan[fn] din. 6 Te sika kangkuwa ne aldew, warad e meinit wey ke maagsil, wey ke salahapun naa.[fn] 7 Ne kein-inuwan seini ne timpu; warad e marusilem, su warad ma tamanan te aldew ne eglayag. Ka Magbebaye ne Manama re ka nakataha ke ken-u seini egkeyitabu.

141 And the day for judging of the Lord God will_come. On that later time, your(pl) enemies will_take_away your(pl) possessions, and divide it there in front of you(pl), (ones) from_Hirusalim. 2 And the Lord God will_gather all peoples of the nations in_order to fight Hirusalim. And that city will_be_snatched and they will_steal the houses, and the women will_be_persuaded to be interfered_with. And the inhabitants will_be_divided; one portion will_be_captured and be_taken there to a far_place, and the other portion will_ still _be_left in the city. 3 And the Lord will_fight against those nations, like his fighting in the past. 4 On that later day, he will_stand on the Mount of Olives there in front of Hirusalim on east side. The mountain will_be_split from the east to the west and the middle will_become a plain like a very_wide valley. And the divided mountain will_stand_opposite_each_other; one portion will_go to the north (LIT left side), and the (other) portion will_go to the south (LIT right side). 5 And you(pl) will_flee from the mountains of the Lord God, and you(pl) will_go by the valley that goes to Askal. You(pl) will_scatter_as_you_run like before when there_was an earthquake when Usiyas was_ still _reigning_over Huda. Afterwards, the Lord my God will_arrive accompanied by his angels.[fn] 6 On that later day, there will_be_no_more heat or cold, or thick_clouds.[fn] 7 And this is amazing time; no evening/darkness anymore, because the sun won't stop shining. Only the Lord God knows when this will_happen.

8 [xr]Ke eggingume e ka sika ne timpu, due eglepew ne weyig due te Hirusalim ne egpakabehey te umul. Egkabaad ka weyig; egtulayas peendiye te Namatey ne Dahat[fn] ka senge-baad, wey ka senge-baad egpekeendiye te Dahat te Miditiranyu.[fn] Ne warad egtamanan te pegtulayas te seeye ne weyig minsan timpu te meinit wey ke lengleng naa. 9 Ne ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka egkeyimu ne Hari te intiru ne kalibutan. Te sika kangkuwa ne aldew, sikandin naan de ka Magbebaye, wey sikandin[fn] naan de ka egsimbeen.

8 [xr]When that day arrives, there's water that can_give life that will_flow (LIT appear) there in Hirusalim. The water will_be_divided; a portion (of water) will_flow to the Dead Sea,[fn] and the other portion will_go to the Miditiranyu Sea.[fn] And there will_be_no_more ending to the flowing of that water even in hot_season or rainy_season. 9 And the Lord God will_become king of the entire world. On that later day, he is the only Lord, and he[fn] is the only one to_be_worshiped.

10 Ne egmapatag e ka intiru ne inged puun te Giba[fn] peendiye te Rimun ne diye dapit te igkakawanan te Hirusalim dapit igsile. Piru kene mule egkaweil ka Hirusalim ne nakatawan-tawan diye te matikang ne bubungan ne nasasindehan te siyudad, puun te Gumawan ni Binhamin peendiye te Tapey ne Gumawan, peendiye te Pikungan ne Gumawan, wey puun te Matikang ne Baley ni Hananil, peendiye te kelesanan te behas te paras te Hari. 11 [xr]Ne masulug e ka me etew ne eg-ugpe te Hirusalim su kenad e egguhusen ka sika ne siyudad, wey warad igkabantali ran ne karereetan.

10 And the entire place will_become flat from Giba[fn] to Rimun in the south (LIT left_side of east) of Hirusalim. But Hirusalim on_the_contrary won't be moved rising on high mountain where the city stood, from the Gateway of Binhamin to the Old Gateway, to the Corner Gateway, and from the Tall House of Hananil, to the pressing_place of the fruit of the grapevines of the king. 11 [xr]And many people will_live in Hirusalim because that city will_ no_longer _be_destroyed, and there's_no destruction that they worry_about.

12 Ne seini ne dalu ka igpasalerep te Magbebaye ne Manama te langun ne keet-etawan ne egkuntere te Hirusalim: egkengammewu ka me sapu dan, ka me mata ran, wey ka me dile dan, minsan mallenggew pad sikandan.

12 And this is the disaster_send by the Lord God to all the people that oppose Hirusalim: their flesh will_rot(pl), their eyes, and their tongues, even though they are still conscious/alive.

13 Ne te sika ne timpu eglibehen sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey egmeg-un-unayey e sikandan egmeggumgumiey. 14 Ne minsan ka Huda, egpakig-ehet degma diye te Hirusalim eyew egpangabangan seini. Ne eglibulungen diye te Hirusalim ka me karatuan te langun ne nasud: ka me bulawan, pelata, wey ka masulug ne me kumbale.

13 And at that time they will_be_confused by the Lord God, and they will personally beat_each_other. 14 And even Huda, will_fight in Hirusalim in_order to protect it. And the wealth of the all nations will_be_gathered there at Hirusalim: gold, silver, and many clothes.

15 Ne egpakasalerep degma te iling ded ne dalu ka me kudde, me mula,[fn] me kamil, me asnu, wey minsan nekey ne ayam ne diye te kampu te me kuntere dan.

15 And the horses, mules,[fn] camels, donkeys, and various domestic_animals there in the camp of their enemies will_ also _suffer_disaster with this similar disease.

16 [xr]Ne ka langun ne nenasame ne me etew te me nasud ne miglusud te Hirusalim, eggendiye te Hirusalim te tagse leg-un eyew egsimba te Hari ne iyan ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, wey eyew egtambung te Sahakeen diye te me Leeb. 17 Ka keet-etawan ne kene eggendiye te Hirusalim eyew egsimba te Hari ne iyan ka Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, kene sikandan egpeuranan. 18 Ka me matig-Ihiptu ne kene eggendiye te Hirusalim, egpakasalerep degma sikandan te legpad te Magbebaye ne Manama iling te duma ne me nasud ne kene egtambung te Sahakeen diye te me Leeb. 19 Ne ka iglegpad te Ihiptu, sikan ded ka iglegpad te langun ne nasud ne kene egtambung te Sahakeen diye te me Leeb.

16 [xr]And all the people who are still alive from the nations that attacked Hirusalim, will_go to Hirusalim each year in_order for worshiping the king who is the Very Strong Lord, and in_order to attend the Feast in Tents. 17 The people who don't go to Hirusalim in_order to worship the king who is the Very Strong Lord, they won't be rained_upon. 18 The (ones) from_Ihiptu who don't go to Hirusalim, will_experience punishment of the Lord God like the other nations who don't attend the Feast in Tents. 19 And the punishment for Ihiptu, just that also will_be_the punishment for all nations who don't attend the Feast in Tents.

20 Te seeye kangkuwa ne aldew, igsulat diye te me saliyew te me kudde ka seini ne lalag: “Inhalad seini ne me kudde diye te Magbebaye ne Manama.” Ne minsan ka me kuren ne diye te timplu, egmatulus degma iling te me yahung ne diye te tangkaan te altar. 21 Ka langun ne kuren diye te Hirusalim wey Huda, egmatulus e diye te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye. Ne ka me talagpanubad, sikan e ne me kuren ka egsubaan dan te ighalad dan. Te sika ne timpu, warad e me nigusyanti[fn] diye te timplu te Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye.

20 On that later day, these words will_be_written on the bells of the horses: “These horses are offered to the Lord God.” And even the cooking_utensils there in the temple, will_become_holy like the bowls that are there in front of the altar. 21 All cooking_utensil that's in Hirusalim and Huda, will_become holy to the Very Strong/Powerful Lord. And the sacrificers, will_use_ those cooking_(utensils) _to_cook their sacrifice. At that time, there will_be_no more merchants[fn] there at/in the temple of the Very Strong/Powerful Lord.
